correctness.rationale: The three realizable nonmeeting pair classes L,S,X have exact substochastic Q from simultaneous independent p-hold/q-move choices. For p,q>0, absorption has positive bounded-step probability. Solve (I−Q)H=1 to obtain H_L=2m(2s+p−1)/[(1−p²)(m+s+p−1)], H_S symmetric, and H_X from its first-step equation. Differences H_L−H_X and H_S−H_X equal F_{m,s}(p)/D and F_{s,m}(p)/D where D=2p(1−p²)(m+s+p−1)>0. Each F strictly increases from negative to positive, zeros straddle 1/3, upper beta<1/2 and lower alpha>(5−√17)/4. m=s balanced tie p=1/3 and s=1 unrealizable S class separately handled. Independent exact rational full-chain small examples and symbolic identities corroborate, all-size conclusion analytic.
